title: The Mystery of Orcival
author: Emile Gaboriau
description: "The Mystery of Orcival" by Émile Gaboriau is a detective novel published in 1867.
longDescription: When poachers discover the Countess of Tremorel's body near her ransacked castle, her husband has vanished and a suspect quickly emerges.

authorInfo.bio: Étienne Émile Gaboriau was a French writer, novelist, journalist, and a pioneer of detective fiction.
